content: In this section, we conduct analyses on two potential usages of word importance, which can help debug NMT models (Section SECREF33) and design better architectures for specific languages (Section SECREF37). Due to the space limitation, we only analyze the results of Chinese$\Rightarrow $English, English$\Rightarrow $French, and English$\Rightarrow $Japanese. We list the results on the reverse directions in Appendix, in which the general conclusions also hold.
